description: Build a multi-tenant surveys module with public/private listings, anonymous or identified responses, secure results, and dashboard management.

userStories.title: Add surveys.manage permission key
userStories.description: As an organization owner or authorized member, I want survey management to depend on a dedicated permission so that survey access is not coupled to generic org admin settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a migration that inserts `surveys.manage` into `public.permissions`.
Update `src/modules/auth/shared/permissions.ts` and `src/modules/auth/shared/permission-presenter.ts` with the new key.
Survey management flows can reference `surveys.manage` without TypeScript errors.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Align survey positions to base-1 ordering
userStories.description: As a developer, I need survey question and option ordering to use one consistent base-1 contract so that validation, persistence, and database constraints do not conflict.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a corrective migration that enforces base-1 positions for `survey_questions.position` and `survey_question_options.position`.
Update survey creation and edit persistence code to write question and option order using base-1 positions.
Ordering constraints remain valid for unique position per survey and per question.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add public respondent identity fields
userStories.description: As a public respondent, I want to submit identified public survey responses with my contact details so that the organization can recognize non-anonymous public submissions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add nullable `respondent_name`, `respondent_email`, and `respondent_phone` columns to `public.survey_responses`.
Identified public responses can persist these fields while anonymous responses keep all three fields null.
Run `npm run db:gen-types` after the schema change.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Enforce response item and survey integrity
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the database to reject answer items that point to questions from another survey so that tampered payloads cannot mix survey data.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a database constraint or trigger that rejects `survey_response_items.question_id` when the question belongs to a different survey than the parent response.
Cross-survey answer payloads fail before data is committed.
Run `npm run db:gen-types` if the schema or views change.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Enable RLS read policies for surveys and questions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need read access to surveys and question data to follow tenant, visibility, and membership rules at the database layer.
acceptanceCriteria: Enable RLS on `surveys`, `survey_questions`, and `survey_question_options`.
Public published available surveys are readable on the public surface while private surveys require active membership.
Owners and members with `surveys.manage` can read management data for their tenant.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Enable RLS write policies for survey responses
userStories.description: As a developer, I need response writes to respect publication state and membership rules at the database layer so unauthorized users cannot submit private survey answers.
acceptanceCriteria: Enable RLS on `survey_responses` and `survey_response_items`.
Allow response inserts only for published available surveys, with private survey writes restricted to active members.
Unauthorized users cannot insert private survey responses.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update safe views for anonymous and identified responses
userStories.description: As a developer, I need safe result projections that hide anonymous identity fields while still allowing authorized dashboard views of identified public respondents.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `survey_responses_safe` and `survey_response_items_safe` so anonymous responses null out user and manual identity fields.
Identified public responses can expose `respondent_name`, `respondent_email`, and `respondent_phone` only through the safe projection.
Regenerate types if view definitions change.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Regenerate Supabase types and survey DB aliases
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the generated database types and survey aliases updated so the module compiles against the final schema and safe views.
acceptanceCriteria: Regenerate `src/shared/types/supabase.d.ts`.
Update `src/modules/surveys/shared/types/db.ts` to reflect the final schema and safe views.
All survey schema imports compile against the regenerated types.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add survey DTO contracts
userStories.description: As a developer, I want DTOs for list, detail, public respondent identity, and results so that server actions do not return raw Supabase rows to the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Expand `src/modules/surveys/shared/types/dto.ts` with DTOs for public list, dashboard list, survey detail, public respondent identity, and results.
Survey actions return camelCase DTOs instead of raw Supabase rows.
Client UI imports DTOs only, not `server/` types.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Refactor public surveys listing backend
userStories.description: As a public visitor, I want the public surveys list backend to return only available tenant surveys so that `/surveys` shows the correct items without extra filtering in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor `list-public-surveys` to return DTOs with `title`, `description`, `status`, `startsAt`, `endsAt`, `visibility`, and `acceptAnonymousAnswers`.
Return only public, published, currently available surveys for the current tenant.
The public list action does not require authentication.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Refactor dashboard surveys listing backend
userStories.description: As an organization member, I want the dashboard surveys list backend to return only tenant surveys I am allowed to see so that `/dashboard/surveys` can render without duplicating access logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor `list-dashboard-surveys` to require authentication and active membership.
Return public and private surveys for the current tenant with status, visibility, and date metadata.
Do not expose respondent or results data in the dashboard list DTO.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Make create-survey persistence atomic
userStories.description: As a survey manager, I want creating a survey with questions and options to succeed or fail as one operation so that drafts are never left partially persisted.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor `create-survey` to authorize `OWNER` or `surveys.manage`.
Validate `title`, `description`, `visibility`, `acceptAnonymousAnswers`, `startsAt`, `endsAt`, and question structure before persistence.
Persist survey, questions, and options atomically using base-1 order.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Block structural edits after first response
userStories.description: As a survey manager, I want the system to lock question and option structure after the first response so that historical answers are never destroyed by later edits.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor `update-survey` to block structural question and option edits after the first response exists.
Return an explicit business code such as `survey_locked_after_response` when the survey is locked.
Permit allowed metadata-only edits after responses without deleting historical response items.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Finalize publish and close survey rules
userStories.description: As a survey manager, I want publish and close actions to enforce the correct business rules so that surveys only become answerable when valid and stop accepting answers when closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor `publish-survey` so publication requires at least one valid question.
Refactor `close-survey` so closing changes status to `closed` and backend response rules treat the survey as unavailable.
Keep explicit business codes for not found, not allowed, and invalid publication state.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add public survey detail loader
userStories.description: As a public visitor, I want the survey detail backend to return only the data needed to answer a public survey so that the public page can render safely and predictably.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a public survey detail loader slice for `src/app/surveys/[surveyId]/page.tsx`.
Resolve the tenant from the current host and return ordered questions and options plus anonymity and availability metadata.
Return business errors for draft, closed, unavailable, or cross-tenant surveys.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add dashboard survey detail loader
userStories.description: As an organization member, I want the dashboard detail backend to load public or private surveys I am allowed to answer so that the member response page can stay thin.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a dashboard survey detail loader slice for member access.
Allow active members to load the current tenant's public and private surveys from the dashboard.
Return explicit membership or authorization errors for non-members or inactive memberships.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Validate response access and payload rules
userStories.description: As a respondent, I want invalid or unauthorized submissions rejected before persistence so that survey answers always match the target survey and access rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate submission access rules before persistence: tenant, status `published`, public or private visibility, and `startsAt` or `endsAt` availability.
Reject answers whose `questionId` does not belong to the loaded survey.
Require `respondent_name`, `respondent_email`, and `respondent_phone` for unauthenticated identified public responses.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Persist responses atomically with dedupe and public snapshot
userStories.description: As a respondent, I want my response saved exactly once with the correct identity mode so that duplicate answers are blocked and identified public submissions keep their contact snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Persist survey responses and response items atomically.
Use authenticated dedupe on `(survey_id, respondent_user_id)` and anonymous or public dedupe on `(survey_id, responder_fingerprint_hash)`.
Persist public respondent snapshot fields only for identified unauthenticated responses and leave them null for anonymous responses.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build results backend for choice and ranking questions
userStories.description: As a survey manager, I want aggregated results for objective and ranking questions so that the dashboard can summarize the main outcomes without client-side counting.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a results backend slice that authorizes `OWNER` or `surveys.manage`.
Return counts and percentages for `single_choice` and `checkbox` questions.
Return an aggregate ordering metric for `ranking` questions.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build textarea and respondent metadata results backend
userStories.description: As a survey manager, I want textarea responses and allowed respondent metadata available in the results backend so that qualitative answers can be reviewed without violating anonymity.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend results backend to return `textarea` responses with `submittedAt` and identity only when the response is not anonymous.
Hide `respondent_user_id`, `respondent_name`, `respondent_email`, and `respondent_phone` for anonymous responses.
Keep results DTOs independent from raw view rows.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create public surveys listing page
userStories.description: As a public visitor, I want a public surveys page that shows the surveys I can answer in this tenant so that I can discover open questionnaires without logging in.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/app/surveys/page.tsx` as a server component that calls the public list action.
Render survey cards with title, short description, status, end date, anonymity info, and response CTA.
Render a clear empty state when no public surveys are available.
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create public survey detail page shell
userStories.description: As a public visitor, I want the public survey detail page to load survey data server-side and render all supported question types so that I can answer the survey with the right context.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/app/surveys/[surveyId]/page.tsx` as a server component that calls the public detail action.
Render the shared survey question renderer for all four question types.
Show `startsAt`, `endsAt`, and unavailable or closed states before any submission happens.

userStories.title: Add public respondent identity and anonymity UX
userStories.description: As an unauthenticated public respondent, I want clear controls for identified versus anonymous response mode so that I know when my name, email, and phone will be collected.
acceptanceCriteria: Add unauthenticated public respondent fields for name, email, and phone.
When anonymous mode is selected, hide or disable the identity fields.
When anonymous mode is not allowed, require the identity fields before submit.
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create dashboard surveys listing page
userStories.description: As an organization member, I want a dashboard surveys index that shows the surveys relevant to my tenant so that I can answer or manage them from one place.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/app/dashboard/surveys/page.tsx` as the dashboard list surface.
Render public and private surveys with status, visibility, dates, and permission-based admin CTAs.
Render a clear empty state when the tenant has no surveys yet.
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Refactor the shared survey builder component
userStories.description: As a survey manager, I want a reusable survey builder that supports the full V1 contract so that create and edit pages do not duplicate complex question form logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor `src/modules/surveys/shared/ui/survey-builder.tsx` to support `title`, `description`, `visibility`, `acceptAnonymousAnswers`, `startsAt`, and `endsAt`.
Support add, remove, and reorder for questions and options using base-1 order.
Render a locked state for structural fields when the survey can no longer change questions.

userStories.title: Create dashboard new survey page
userStories.description: As a survey manager, I want a dedicated dashboard page for creating a new survey so that I can build a draft from the UI without touching the database manually.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/app/dashboard/surveys/new/page.tsx` and wire it to the create survey action.
Restrict access to `OWNER` or `surveys.manage`.
Allow creating a draft and show success feedback or redirect after save.

userStories.title: Create dashboard edit and manage survey page
userStories.description: As a survey manager, I want a dashboard page for editing metadata and managing publication state so that I can update, publish, and close surveys from one screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/app/dashboard/surveys/[surveyId]/edit/page.tsx` and wire it to update, publish, and close actions.
Disable structural editing when the survey is locked after responses.
Show publish and close controls that reflect current status and user permission.

userStories.title: Create dashboard member response page
userStories.description: As an organization member, I want to answer public or private surveys from the dashboard using the same renderer as the public surface so that the experience stays consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/app/dashboard/surveys/[surveyId]/page.tsx` for member response flows.
Allow active members to answer public and private surveys with the shared renderer and the same validation rules as the public surface.

userStories.title: Create dashboard results page
userStories.description: As a survey manager, I want a dashboard results page that visualizes survey answers so that I can inspect quantitative and qualitative responses in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/app/dashboard/surveys/[surveyId]/results/page.tsx`.
Render summary cards and per-question result blocks, including textarea entries and identified respondent metadata when allowed.
Render a clear empty state when the survey has no responses.

userStories.title: Wire dashboard navigation and localized survey badges
userStories.description: As a user, I want surveys to be discoverable in the dashboard and to use consistent status and visibility labels so that I can recognize survey state at a glance.
